units.source_text: 每逢夕暮时分，请你留意眺望天空。

en.t: Whenever evening falls, please take care to look up at the sky.

units.source_text: 我已成为亡魂，旁人不会怪你，你可安心眺望。

en.t: I will already have become a departed spirit, and no one will blame you, so you may look without fear.

units.source_text: 虽已徒然无益，仍望你永远爱我！”

en.t: Though it is now futile and useless, I still hope you will love me forever!"

units.source_text: 杂乱无章地写完了信，觉得心情更加恶劣了。

en.t: After finishing the letter in a confused and disorderly way, he felt even worse.
Then he said to Ko Jijū, "Enough!

units.source_text: 不可过分夜深，你早些儿回去，把我已将临终的情况告诉她吧。

en.t: Do not let the night grow too late; go back early and tell her that I am already near my end.

units.source_text: 我今死去，世人还要讶怪我缘何而死，真教我死后也很痛苦。

en.t: If I die now, people will still wonder in surprise why I died, and that will make me suffer even after death.

units.source_text: 我前世不知作了什么恶孽，以致今生有这等痛心之事。”

en.t: I do not know what evil karma I created in a former life to have such a heartbreaking thing happen in this one."

units.source_text: 他一面哭泣，一面膝行而去，回到病榻上。

en.t: Crying as he went, he shuffled away on his knees and returned to his sickbed.

units.source_text: 小侍从回想柏木从前和她相见，总是久坐长谈，或竟杂以戏言，絮絮聒聒地无有尽期。

en.t: Ko Jijū remembered how, when Kashiwagi used to meet with her, he would always sit for a long time and talk, sometimes even mixing in jokes, chattering on without end.
This time, however, he said very little.

units.source_text: 她觉得可怜，不忍立刻回去。

en.t: She pitied him and could not bear to leave at once.

units.source_text: 柏木的乳母也把柏木的病状说给小侍从听，两人都哭得很悲伤。

en.t: Kashiwagi's nurse also told Ko Jijū about his condition, and the two of them wept in deep sorrow.

units.source_text: 大臣愁苦得更厉害，说道：“这几天已经稍稍好转，何以今天又如此衰弱了？”

en.t: The minister grew still more distressed and said, "He had become a little better these past few days, so why has he grown so weak again today?"
Kashiwagi answered, "How could I possibly be getting better!
In the end, there is no hope left!"
As he said this, he too began to cry.
